description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: lib/zaq/engine/connect/mutation_events.ex owns fixed version 1 allowlisted payload (UUID event_id, integer credential_id, nullable grant_id/owner_type/owner_id, kind, occurred_at; no revision). MutationEventWorker in Connect namespace invokes existing Agent.Events synchronous helper -> NodeRouter.dispatch/1. Only response :ok counts delivered; unsupported/unavailable/RPC/unexpected/exception/exit return fixed sanitized retry errors, never provider bodies. Same Repo transaction for mutation plus real Oban job across canonical and legacy credential create/update/delete, grant issue/replace/revoke/remove, token cache and refresh shared persistence. Capture deletion identity from persisted row before removal. No duplicates from delegated config saves. No secret attrs/structs/metadata in job or workflow stream. No triggers/general framework. Dedicated connect_credential_notifications queue remains absent from all production/dev consumers until actual Agent receiver/fanout; always enqueue despite disabled consumption. Existing max_attempts/backoff conventions.

Tests to add before implementation: real Repo/Oban with manual test mode (inline dispatches before commit); canonical/legacy all mutations, configuration atomic rollback and nested rollback; enqueue DB failure aborts writes; captured deletion IDs; secret sentinel/property allowlist; duplicate/reordered retries keep UUID; exact synchronous Agent event; actual default NodeRouter unsupported Agent response; no queue consumption across role configs.

Branches/paths validated: successful/no-op/failed mutation, absent cleanup, deletion cascade identity, shared token persistence, malformed payloads, unsupported/unavailable/RPC/exception failures, safe logs, stable retry identity. Delivery is at-least-once attempts with bounded retry; no consumer acknowledgment or all-node fanout guarantee. Future consumers re-read current state. Queue activation, backlog retention/replay and discarded-job handling require explicit later integration; no silent pruning of old dead jobs.

Mocking plan: real Repo/Oban/internal modules; NodeRouter injection only through existing event-helper opts at service boundary for dispatch outcomes; actual default routing rejection test. No global config mutation, no Agent stub receiver, no direct PubSub, no ServerManager.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/: new moduledocs, docs/services/engine.md transactional event schema and deferred consumer integration; docs/architecture.md delivery/retention guarantees; config comments and manual Oban guidance. Validation: mix format, focused tests, touched application-file coverage >=95%, mix q, git diff --check; record exact commands/results/limits in Beadwork. Completed-uncommitted remains in_progress pending merge. Dependency .2 -> .3 -> .5 -> .6 -> .7 -> .4 -> .8 -> .9; preserve .1/.2 state and user work.

comments.text: Superseding storage decision: grants use polymorphic owner_type/owner_id and canonical resource_type=connect_credential with server-derived resource_id=credential_id::text; no duplicate grant person_id or binding_type. A semantic person_id in an allowlisted event, if retained, derives from owner_type=person plus owner_id, not a schema field. Event detail and delivery plan otherwise retained. Storage implementation is blocked on repeatable-read referential integrity; see zaq-jrg.1 and docs/services/connect-person-trigger-blocker.md.

Claimed via update: bw start refuses because .2 remains in_progress awaiting merge. User explicitly approved proceeding from implemented/reviewed .1/.2 without closing them. Initial workspace clean at d0c0df9b. DAG verified acyclic in both directions with external dependencies preserved.

Completed-uncommitted implementation; remains in_progress pending independent review and merge. Production files: new Connect.MutationEvents (persist/2, delete/1, validate/1, deliver/2), new MutationEventWorker; Connect and Mutations route both lanes through transactional persistence. Fixed v1 JSON allowlist: UUID event_id; integer credential_id; nullable grant_id/owner_type/owner_id; fixed kind; UTC occurred_at. No revision, metadata, secrets, Agent receiver/stub, direct PubSub or ServerManager. Credential deletion event covers all cascaded scopes; grant deletion reloads/locks persisted owner identity. Shared token-cache/refresh path enqueues once. Delegated configuration saves do not duplicate credential events. Empty updates/absent cleanup silent, replacements/forced erasure observable. Dedicated connect_credential_notifications queue absent across dev/prod/all role configs; enqueue unconditional. Synchronous existing Agent.Events helper -> NodeRouter; only response :ok completes. Unsupported/unavailable/RPC/unexpected/exception/exit/throw map to safe fixed retry error. Three attempts/default Oban backoff; exhausted jobs retained. Activation deferred to real receiver/fanout plus explicit retention/replay/discarded-job policy; no consumer acknowledgment/fanout/historical replay guarantee. Docs: engine.md and architecture.md. Test config manual; E2E=1 uses real asynchronous queues with notification queue absent. Existing workflow recovery/token aggregation/webhook tests now explicitly scope their intended inline operation after credential fixtures; committed concurrency fixtures clean only their own new jobs.
